title: Firebase removed the firebase/vertexai import alias
description: Firebase JavaScript SDK 12.0.0 removes the firebase/vertexai import alias and directs users to firebase/ai.
oldBehavior: The application imports Firebase AI functionality from firebase/vertexai.
newBehavior: The application imports Firebase AI functionality from firebase/ai.
migrationInstructions: Replace the exact firebase/vertexai import specifier with firebase/ai.
Review method names and SDK behavior separately; this rule changes only the module specifier.

evidenceSources.summary: Official Firebase JavaScript release notes identify firebase/vertexai as removed and firebase/ai as the replacement.

review.notes: Reviewed against the official Firebase release notes. The executable transformation is limited to exact import specifier replacement.

assumptions: The source establishes the module alias boundary but not method-level compatibility.
Only exact static import specifiers are eligible for a deterministic proposal.
Every generated patch remains subject to verification and human approval.
